title: fix(ui): dataset callers send the reader's package (?callerPackage=) instead of the exact qualifier, and the report date read and chart colour probe read by package (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
Fixes #32311

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of the ADR-0150 epic #31527 (child card). Resumed from the card thread's pushed head (`claude/project-thread-l26e7m` at `b30ac853`, Resume-from 6787875809); every earlier commit was re-read hunk by hunk and kept, and all verification below was re-run on this branch.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:仪表盘、报表、列表视图图表读取已保存数据集时,改为把所属包作为读者包发送(`?callerPackage=`,ADR-0150 D3),不再发精确限定符 `?package=`;报表的日期维度读取和图表的选项颜色探测也同样带上读者包。无包的条目仍什么都不发。
- 为什么改:#32309 发的 `?package=` 是精确限定符,包 P 里的仪表盘/报表若引用的数据集只在 P 的依赖里,会被 `409` 拒绝;服务端 #32310 已提供读者包解析,这里让界面改用它,把依赖场景恢复。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,只放宽(原来 `409` 的依赖场景现在能读到);无元数据或存储形状变化。回滚即 revert 本 PR,行为退回 `?package=`。
- 先看:`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`(`datasetQueryAddress` 与批量分组)、`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportDateRange.tsx`(读取键加入调用包)、`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`(颜色探测带读者包、非 2xx 不解析)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts`,预期全绿,其中 caller arm 一组断言 URL 只带 `callerPackage`、不带 `package`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(落地前须经 epic 红线复核)。

## What changes

A saved dataset is now read for the package of the item that names it, sent as the reader's package `?callerPackage=` (ADR-0150 D3), instead of the exact qualifier `?package=` (ADR-0150 D5). The server resolves the name for that reader: its own dataset, else the one holder in its dependency closure plus `sys`, else `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the candidates.

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `queryDataset` and `queryDatasetBatch` take an optional `callerPackage` beside `packageId`. One helper, `datasetQueryAddress`, builds the query string: only for a saved dataset NAME, nothing for an empty value or an inline draft, and both arms if a caller sets both (the server refuses that pair `400`; it is not guessed here). The batch groups by the full address, so two callers never share a request.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: `DatasetWidget` sends the dashboard's served package as `callerPackage`. The coalescer's group key now carries the caller package, so two packages' queries never share one batch.
- `@object-ui/plugin-report`: the report's selections, joined blocks included, send `callerPackage`. `useReportDateDimension` (`GET /meta/dataset/NAME`) takes the report's package and reads as that reader. The caller package is part of the read's identity.
- `@object-ui/plugin-charts`: the dataset-bound query and the option-colour probe (`GET /meta/dataset/NAME`) both send `callerPackage`, so both resolve the same dataset. A non-2xx probe answer is not parsed as a definition, and the chart keeps the theme palette.
- `app-shell` (private): a comment update on the list-view chart's package prop, plus a pin that the view's `_packageId` reaches the chart.

A `409` is never retried bare. A package-less item (no `_packageId`, or the `sys_metadata` / `__runtime__` sentinels) and an inline dataset send nothing. The caller-arm spelling was verified on `origin/main` first: `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` reads `?callerPackage=` on both dataset doors, and `meta-item-read-gate.ts` reads it on `/meta`.

## Tests

Pins per caller: each sends the item's package as the caller; a dependency's dataset renders; CONTROL, a package-less item sends nothing; a `409` is shown and never retried bare.

- adapter: `queryDataset.test.ts`, a new describe for the caller arm (single door, batch door, inline-draft split, a lone batch query falling back to the single door, a server with no batch door).
- coalescer: `datasetQueryBatch.test.ts`, one batch per caller, and the caller arm kept apart from the exact qualifier.
- dashboard: `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` and `DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx`, on both `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`.
- report: `DatasetReportRenderer.test.tsx` and `DatasetReportRenderer.dateRange-25873.test.tsx`. The second gains a pin added in this resume: the same report served from another package re-reads the definition and never windows on the first package's date dimension.
- chart: `ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx` and `ObjectChart.datasetMeasureLabel.test.tsx`.
- list view: `ObjectView.chartConfigForward-7891.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②` was measured on the built declaration closure. The four published packages were built from this branch and from `origin/main` source, and their `dist` declarations diffed. The only change reachable from a package `exports` entry is `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `ObjectStackAdapter.queryDataset` / `queryDatasetBatch` options, which gain an optional `callerPackage` (in both `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`). `DatasetQueryOptions` (plugin-dashboard) and `useReportDateDimension`'s new optional third parameter (plugin-report) change only in internal `.d.ts` files that neither package's `"."` entry re-exports. Nothing narrows. On the server, every case `?package=P` answered is answered the same or now served by `?callerPackage=P`.
- The pending `32077-dataset-query-package` changeset (BREAKING, interim) names this card as the follow-up that restores the dependency case. This PR's changeset says what it restores, and what stays refused as `outside-closure` (a holder outside P's declared dependency closure; a dataset authored in the environment), with the fix. If both ship in one release, that note's TO line is no longer accurate for the dependency case. Amending it is a separate decision for the seat (it is outside this card's changeset file).
- A10 below: the chart probe's non-2xx guard is behaviour-neutral by construction. An ADR-0112 `409` envelope names no `object`, so the probe ends with no option colours with or without it. It is kept so a non-2xx body is never parsed as a definition; no test can tell the two apart.
- Seen, not filed (dormant): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx` `handleDatasetDrill` still reads `metadataClient.get('dataset', NAME)` bare. That branch runs only for an older server with no drill metadata; current servers take the fast path above it.

## Epic red lines (`epic:#31527`, the three the review of #32309 applied)

- **1, never loosen.** The client loosens no refusal and adds no fallback. What is now served beyond the exact qualifier is exactly the server's ADR-0150 D3 resolution, the target that epic ruling named for this card. The `sys_metadata` / `__runtime__` sentinels still name no package. The maintainer-ruled refusals in `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` are untouched: 46 `ruling|maintainer|⛔` hits on `main`, 46 on this head, and 0 diff lines touch one.
- **2, never guess.** Nothing retries bare: a `409` is surfaced (widget, report block, date range) or keeps the theme palette (colour probe). A package-less item and an inline draft send nothing. Both arms set are both sent, so the server answers `400` and the client never picks one. The caller package is part of every query signature, of the coalescer's group key and of the date read's key, so no answer crosses packages.
- **3, releasable.** The changeset declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at `patch`, names what this does to the pending `32077` BREAKING note, and says what stays refused and how to fix it.

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.

NOT MEASURED locally: `app-shell` type-check, whose closure is not built in this worktree (TS2307 on unbuilt workspace deps, not on the diff); CI's `Type Check UI` covers it.

</details>
